sections.heading: A real machine, outside
sections.text: We are bringing a working mini skid steer loader to the 140th China Import and Export Fair, better known as the Canton Fair. It will be at our outdoor booth, 12.0B34, and you are welcome to come and try it.

sections.heading: One machine, eight attachments
sections.text: Our stand banner shows the loader with eight quick-change attachments: bucket, fork, auger, sweeper, rotary tiller, breaker, snow blower and crab bucket. Ask the team which of them suit your model and the work you have in mind.

sections.heading: When and where
sections.text: Phase 1 of the fair, which includes the construction machinery section, runs from 15 to 19 October 2026 at the China Import and Export Fair Complex in Guangzhou.

title: A closer look. A stronger connection.
excerpt: Overseas customers visited BOB-LIFT to see the workshop, assembly and testing areas, and discuss future cooperation.
caption: Customer-visit image published on the BOB-LIFT main website.

sections.heading: Inside the BOB-LIFT operation
sections.text: BOB-LIFT reported a visit by overseas customers to its production workshop, assembly area, product display and testing facilities. The visit followed the manufacturing process from raw-material processing and welding to assembly and quality inspection.

sections.heading: A conversation about future work
sections.text: The company announcement describes demonstrations of lifting and aerial-work equipment, followed by discussions about applications, market requirements and cooperation. It offers a view of the wider BOB-LIFT business behind this compact equipment website.

sections.heading: Visit with your project in mind
sections.text: If you would like to discuss a visit or a compact equipment project, contact the BOB-LIFT team in advance with your interests and proposed schedule.

title: The work behind the machine.
excerpt: A look at the production, assembly and testing processes described by the BOB-LIFT manufacturing team.
caption: BOB-LIFT manufacturing photograph from the original company announcement.

sections.heading: From material to complete equipment
sections.text: In its June manufacturing update, BOB-LIFT describes the sequence behind its lifting equipment: raw-material processing, structural-component manufacture, assembly, and complete-machine debugging. The announcement focuses on the company’s truck-mounted cranes and aerial work platforms.

sections.heading: Attention to the systems inside
sections.text: The report discusses inspection of hydraulic and electrical components, followed by checks of operating condition, performance and key functions after assembly. These are statements about the parent company’s published manufacturing activity, rather than specifications for every product on this website.

sections.heading: Explore the company behind the range
sections.text: Visit the original announcement for the full story and photographs, or contact our compact equipment team to discuss product-specific information.

title: Connecting at CTT EXPO 2026.
excerpt: BOB-LIFT’s announcement for the May 26–29, 2026 construction machinery exhibition in Moscow.
caption: Exhibition artwork published with BOB-LIFT’s CTT EXPO 2026 announcement.

sections.heading: The original exhibition announcement
sections.text: On May 20, 2026, BOB-LIFT announced plans to participate in CTT EXPO at Crocus Expo IEC in Moscow. The announcement listed May 26–29, 2026 as the exhibition dates and booth 2-415 as the company’s location.

sections.heading: Lifting equipment and business conversations
sections.text: The planned display focused on truck-mounted cranes and lifting solutions. The announcement invited customers and partners to discuss BOB-LIFT products and applications with the team.

sections.heading: Continue the conversation
sections.text: This is an archive of the company’s exhibition announcement; the listed event dates are in the past. For current exhibitions, product availability or a meeting with the compact equipment team, contact BOB-LIFT directly.
